item.title: Guard Core: Quadratic ReDoS in built-in detection pattern freezes the event loop with a single request
item.description: Summary A polynomial (quadratic) regular-expression denial of service in guard-core's built-in penetration-detection patterns allows any unauthenticated remote client to freeze every endpoint of an application for seconds per request, using only the default configuration. item.title: k8s-mcp-server: Missing authentication on default SSE/HTTP transport allows unauthenticated Kubernetes tool execution
item.description: Summary When k8s-mcp-server runs in its default SSE transport mode, the MCP tools/call endpoint is dispatched with no authentication, session token, or Origin check. Any client that can reach the listening port can enumerate and invoke the server's Kubernetes tools (including destructive/write tools) without credentials, executing with the server's configured cluster privileges. item.title: containerd image-triggered daemon crash via malformed digest in subject-annotated descriptor
item.description: Impact A bug in containerd's image manifest processing causes an unrecovered panic when a child descriptor contains the io.containerd.manifest.subject annotation and a malformed digest. Pulling or importing such an image through the transfer service (including default CRI PullImage requests) crashes the containerd daemon.
